svg.text: Today's node size and heights. The 13 inputs zigzag between two lines, keeping neighbors as far apart as today's.
Nearest node centers 26.9 px apart (meets the 24 px spacing)

Red rings mark nodes that a line cuts through. Line colors and widths, and node fills, are random, as if mid forward pass.
